need: The StarCi Skills landing page must keep bounded artwork centered, use the approved yellow-purple brand treatment, give every skill card a meaningful vector icon, and signal independently scrollable operator regions with visible scroll shadows.
negativeBoundary: Do not redesign the page structure, replace semantic status colors, add generated raster icons to skill cards, or change operator and skill behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The StarCi logo and decorative brand accents use the approved yellow-purple palette without changing the logo composition.
Every rendered skill card includes a crisp semantic Phosphor vector icon with the yellow-purple treatment.
Section artwork remains horizontally centered inside the shared section shell at wide viewports.
The operator domain rail and operator list use bounded scroll shadows and branded scrollbars without changing their scroll behavior.
A build-blocking regression test covers the icon treatment, centered artwork, and scroll-shadow bindings.

accepts: Use yellow and purple as the primary logo and decorative accent colors.
Center the operator artwork that is visibly offset in the supplied wide-screen screenshot.
Add semantic vector icons to every skill card and use scroll shadows on nested scroll regions.
rejects: Keep the blue-coral logo treatment after the user explicitly selected yellow-purple.
Leave section artwork aligned to the viewport edge instead of the bounded shell.
Use raster or emoji skill icons, or rely on a native scrollbar alone to communicate nested overflow.

review.rationale: The site build and focused regressions pass. Browser proof confirms 12 vector icons, zero-pixel artwork center drift, bounded scroll shadows, and no horizontal overflow at a 391 CSS-pixel mobile viewport.
